name: Morning Briefing
prompt: Generate a morning briefing. Check: 1) Weather for my city (use the weather skill). 2) Calendar: FIRST run `date '+%A %Y-%m-%d'` to get today's real date. Then generate a 7-day weekday lookup table by running: `for i in 0 1 2 3 4 5 6; do date -v+${i}d '+%Y-%m-%d %a'; done` -- this is the ONLY source of truth for day names (never compute day-of-week in your head, LLMs get this wrong). Pull calendar events for the next 7 days. When labeling upcoming events, look up each event's date in the lookup table to get the correct day name. 3) Unread emails needing attention (skip newsletters/promos). 4) Any project updates from STATE.md files. Format as a concise daily brief with sections: Weather, Schedule, Emails, Projects. Start with the date.

name: Evening Debrief
prompt: End of day check-in. 1) What was on the calendar today? 2) Any unread emails that need attention before tomorrow? 3) Ask: 'Anything you want to capture before wrapping up?' Keep it conversational and short.

name: Gmail Promo Cleanup
_comment: COST WARNING: This LLM-based job costs ~22k tokens per run ($12-15/day). Replace with scripts/gmail-cleanup-sweep.sh via launchd for zero-cost polling. The shell script handles Gmail's thread-scoped search quirks and index lag. See docs/GMAIL-CLEANUP.md.
prompt: Clean up old promotional emails. Search for promotions older than 6 months and trash up to 50 per run. When done, respond with exactly: HEARTBEAT_OK
